name: Scott
bio: Under the name Scott the paper refers to Editor Scott of the Dickinson Press, its rival in a 1884 argument over the Medora freight route, who married that spring. A different Scott appears in August 1886 as the partner of a prisoner, who escaped from Dickinson and had not been heard from.

moments.label: Sparred with the Cow Boy over the Medora freight route
